passport.model: NT3_PRV_ch48 (streamable CNN: close, HL/2, HLC/3 steps + bar range, 48 channels, head 161 -> 96 -> 1; side inputs: window divisor and the 200 bars before the window, in bars; no clock, no EMA)
passport.training: prod: all data of 31 assets (FIT + TUNE + VALIDATION), 20 epochs, cosine lr

inputs.bar_time: open time of the bar, UTC milliseconds (only for grid gaps)
inputs.norm: median(high - low) over the 200 bars before the bar (closed left); even count: mean of the two middle
inputs.valid_bar: norm finite and > 0, no grid gap (interval > 450000 ms on 5M; 1.5 bars in general), previous bar exists, previous bar has a norm (for d of HL/2, HLC/3)
inputs.step_p: (p - close[1]) / norm - (p[1] - close[1]) / norm[1], p = HL/2 and HLC/3
inputs.window: last 64 bars t-63 .. t, all valid; first bar s = t - 63 needs >= 200 bars before it
inputs.divisor_D: max(median |r| over the window (even: mean of two middle), floor of the symbol)
inputs.pooling: layer 4 outputs at the last 33 bars of the chosen stream: mean, max, last (144); each / D

history.bars: 200 bars s-200 .. s-1 before the window, consecutive bars (time and grid gaps are not looked at); nothing deeper; the bar s-1 enters only the scales and vol inputs
history.scales: rmed = median(high - low) over s-200 .. s-1 (= norm of bar s); rmean = mean(high - low) over s-200 .. s-1; bmed = max(median |close - open| over s-200 .. s-1, 0.05 * rmed)
history.chunks: [71, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 2] bars, oldest first, over s-200 .. s-2

side: log_D = log(D), D = max(median |r| over the 64 bars of the window, floor of the symbol)
log_mean_abs_r = log(max(mean |r| over the 64 bars of the window, floor of the symbol))

path_71: chunk 1/8 of the path before the window (71 bars; chunks of 71, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 2 bars over bars s-200 .. s-2, oldest first): (close of its last bar - open of its first bar) / sqrt(71) / rmed, clipped to +-20, times the orientation sign

path_64: chunk 2/8 of the path before the window (64 bars; chunks of 71, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 2 bars over bars s-200 .. s-2, oldest first): (close of its last bar - open of its first bar) / sqrt(64) / rmed, clipped to +-20, times the orientation sign

path_32: chunk 3/8 of the path before the window (32 bars; chunks of 71, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 2 bars over bars s-200 .. s-2, oldest first): (close of its last bar - open of its first bar) / sqrt(32) / rmed, clipped to +-20, times the orientation sign

path_16: chunk 4/8 of the path before the window (16 bars; chunks of 71, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 2 bars over bars s-200 .. s-2, oldest first): (close of its last bar - open of its first bar) / sqrt(16) / rmed, clipped to +-20, times the orientation sign

path_8: chunk 5/8 of the path before the window (8 bars; chunks of 71, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 2 bars over bars s-200 .. s-2, oldest first): (close of its last bar - open of its first bar) / sqrt(8) / rmed, clipped to +-20, times the orientation sign

path_4: chunk 6/8 of the path before the window (4 bars; chunks of 71, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 2 bars over bars s-200 .. s-2, oldest first): (close of its last bar - open of its first bar) / sqrt(4) / rmed, clipped to +-20, times the orientation sign

path_2a: chunk 7/8 of the path before the window (2 bars; chunks of 71, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 2 bars over bars s-200 .. s-2, oldest first): (close of its last bar - open of its first bar) / sqrt(2) / rmed, clipped to +-20, times the orientation sign

path_2b: chunk 8/8 of the path before the window (2 bars; chunks of 71, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 2 bars over bars s-200 .. s-2, oldest first): (close of its last bar - open of its first bar) / sqrt(2) / rmed, clipped to +-20, times the orientation sign
range_pos = 2 * (close[s-2] - lmin) / (hmax - lmin) - 1 (0 if hmax = lmin), hmax / lmin = max high / min low over bars s-200 .. s-2 (199 bars), times the orientation sign
range_width = log(max(hmax - lmin, 1e-12) / (sqrt(199) * rmed)), clipped to +-5, no sign
close_dev = (close[s-2] - mean close over bars s-200 .. s-2) / (sqrt(199) * rmed), clipped to +-20, times the orientation sign
vol_16 = log(max(mean(high - low) over bars s-16 .. s-1 / rmean, 0.001)), clipped to +-5, no sign
vol_64 = log(max(mean(high - low) over bars s-64 .. s-1 / rmean, 0.001)), clipped to +-5, no sign
range_mean_med = log(max(rmean / rmed, 0.001)), clipped to +-5, no sign
body_med = log(max(bmed / rmed, 0.001)), clipped to +-5, no sign
inputs.side_nan: NaN -> 0 after the clips (cannot occur on a valid window: rmed > 0)
inputs.side_sign: the orientation sign of the window (tie_rule) multiplies the signed inputs (model.side_signed)
inputs.head: logit = head3_w . relu(head0_w @ [pooled(144), side_std(17)] + head0_b) + head3_b

tie_rule.x_end: sum_{i=0..63} i * r_i / 64 over the window (end of the centered close path)
tie_rule.rule: sgn = -1 if x_end < -eps * D else +1; one sign for the stream and the side inputs

floors.unknown_rule: median of floor_L64 of the 31 table symbols
floors.source: smc_series files of the prod training: fresh data folder for BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, research data folder for the rest

calibration.lift: exp(platt_a * logit + platt_b), Platt of the symbol
calibration.fit_on: VAL of the 'refit' models on the prod set of 31 assets (training up to 2025-06-30), seeds a + b together, whole VAL of the symbol

unknown_symbol.fit_on: VAL of the 'refit' models on set C (FIL, LINK, XLM unseen), 31 assets, seeds a + b

transfer_check.rule: per symbol, 'stop' C -> 'refit' C (v5.2), |total - 1| <= 0.10 at 1.25 and 0.8

display.line: M = exp(|platt_a * logit + platt_b|); more frequent than random if platt_a * logit + platt_b > 0, less frequent if < 0; floor 1.0
display.threshold: visual only: input >= 1, default 3 (bright above, pale below, dashed line, optional marks)
display.ceiling_rule: docs/rules.md R12 (R9 on the pool with the Platt of each symbol from the other half; R11 per symbol: the lower edge of the first bin where factual / expected < 0.8 or < 1000 windows of a class; unknown symbol: the lowest of FIL, LINK, XLM with the global Platt); above the ceiling the line stays at it, "N+"
display.unknown_symbol: not Binance spot from the table (prefix BINANCE, no .P): floor, Platt and ceilings of the unknown symbol + note
display.timeframe: the same computation on any timeframe (bars only); 5M only checked: other timeframes drawn with a note

warmup.rule: docs/rules.md R13: no line while the window is invalid or has < 200 bars before its first bar; first valid r and steps at bar_index 201, first window 201 .. 264
